scope: Separate C201 input-binding validator, dedicated fixture CPU controls and component documentation only. No complete production lock, coordinator, host sealing or native readiness approval.

findings.finding: Double-leading-slash path spelling bypassed textual output/input ancestry checks while inode uniqueness still passed.
findings.evidence: draft-path-control.json and draft-independent-controls.json; actual public validator accepted a nested output.
findings.resolution: Absolute path validation rejects //; final public validator independently rejects the nested spelling.

findings.finding: Preseeding reached with frozen inputs skipped traversing their dependency edges. Root and reviewer independently identified this in draft source.
findings.evidence: Manual draft inspection; repaired before first independent full control run.
findings.resolution: Initialize reached empty and include frozen inputs in frontier. Positive control with a dependency reachable only through the frozen constructor passes.

findings.finding: Initial generic argv matching and minimal environment could not represent the qualified clean native environment.
findings.resolution: Exact inherited safe Blender flags/job commands, exact Node policy/loader, per-slot empty native-environment roots and expanded environment variables. Independent controls reject unsafe changes even after fixture plan reseal.

findings.finding: A single host namespace required disjoint from repo/output roots could not represent real OS/runtime paths spanning directories.
findings.evidence: Manual design review against current-host full-closure requirement.
findings.resolution: Host namespace can be /; individual bound host and gate input files remain disjoint from repository, authority and writable roots. Independent positive and overlap rejection controls pass.

findings.finding: Node command consumes one loader path; role must not silently accept unused additional loader members.
findings.resolution: Exact singleton node_loader check present; final independent control rejects extra member.

remainingRequirements: Independent bootstrap must establish actual Git/current interpreter identities and persist/authenticate the trusted context and fixed authority across restarts.

Complete actual transitive imports, OS/runtime and alias inventories remain a separate sealing/integration gate. Current validator conservatively rejects symlinks/hardlinks; it does not discover dynamic dependencies or prove completeness from a graph.
Actual C201 transaction/readback/coordinator compatibility, accepted-source regeneration resolution, equality/sibling checks, cleanup/deadlines and atomic promotion remain pending.

Validation is a read-only preflight snapshot. Runtime retention/revalidation and creation/verification of environment subdirectories must precede any actual launch; initial empty-directory checks cannot substitute for runtime safety.
Independent real binding/native-readiness approval must precede the sole four/four/four invocation; image and independent result reviews follow execution.
nextGate: Integrate this exact reviewed component only after root-owned applicable checks. Next bounded development is separately reviewed C201 transaction/readback compatibility; preserve production sealing, bootstrap and native-readiness gates.
